# QFace

`ai_workbench/core/qq_faces.json` contains the QQ system-face ID, label and static-image mapping derived from QFace 1.4.1 (`lib/data.json`), distributed under the accompanying MIT license. Source: https://github.com/koishijs/QFace.

Only the mapping is bundled. Image resources are fetched on demand from the QFace static/GIF URLs and retained by the normal attachment store. No QFace JavaScript or frontend dependencies are installed. Unknown IDs remain unavailable media.
